reason: This task's own contracts: embed_batch/EmbeddingError signature, replace_chunks' no-commit rule, the single-transaction boundary that R2's atomicity depends on, and the worker function list.
Ordered checklist with the DeepInfra probe as a hard first step and the compose wiring as a hard last step, plus the review gates.
Documents the atomic-claim (UPDATE...WHERE status RETURNING) and stale-PROCESSING-reset patterns that embedding/worker.py must replicate for index_status.
Defines the per-episode try/except-then-FAILED worker pattern and the one-exception-class-per-stage convention that EmbeddingError must follow, mirroring TranscribeError.
Establishes the stage-module layout (interface / concrete / worker / cli split) that the new files (four under embedding/, one under indexing/) must mirror.
The worker's per-episode progress and failure logs are the only observability this task ships (no unit tests, per R6), so they must follow the project's level/format conventions.
